The allegation of an absent real-LUB prerequisite is false for the originally observed source closure: lem-qsm-matrix-state-calculus -> def-real-and-complex-inner-product-space -> def-complex-conjugate-real-imaginary-part-and-modulus -> cor-cauchy-reals-lub-complete. The full complex Definition literally states “The real numbers are least-upper-bound complete” and cites that exact Cauchy-real theorem. This matches the real field used by F4; no Dedekind/Cauchy transport is missing. The bounded nonempty Rayleigh-value set therefore has a real supremum; continuity/density supplies the least-index approximants, without Countable Choice, and F1 attains the maximum. Native Alpha36 has additionally made this existing premise explicit as F5 and checked the whole five-step proof; this is exposition/citation enrichment, not proof of a previously unsupported spectral theorem. Current finite KMS Proof1.1/2.1/2.2/3.1 uses the unchanged spectral/trace clauses correctly, including D=1 and degeneracy.
